# GXP-Storage

GXP-Storage is a Warehousing and Storage company. GXP-Storage® is an integrated regulated research and manufacturing material lifecycle management leader. They transform fragmented storage into strategic lifecycle regulated material management, with a capacity for millions of cubic feet. They have partnerships with 1,000+ organizations and offer expertise and leadership in various areas. GXP-Storage employs 17 people (+6.2% YoY, +1 person), founded in 1995. Headquartered in Middlesex, North Carolina, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom.

## About

GXP-Storage® is a regulated material management company helping life sciences organizations reduce the complexity and risk associated with fragmented regulated storage. We provide temperature-controlled storage, lifecycle management services, and validated technology solutions supporting physical materials & electronic records across preclinical, clinical, manufacturing, and healthcare operations.

We manage a broad range of regulated and environmentally sensitive materials – from preclinical research materials and clinical trial samples to APIs and retention samples. Our purpose-built, ISO-certified facilities support storage conditions ranging from controlled ambient to cryogenic. 

Our international network of regulated material management facilities is strategically located near major life sciences hubs, manufacturing centers, and logistics infrastructure, including Research Triangle Park in the US and the UK’s Golden Triangle. Together, these facilities provide millions of cubic feet of secure, temperature and access-controlled storage designed to support long-term lifecycle continuity.

Our digital-native GXP-Guardian® platform was developed specifically for regulated material management, unifying physical inventory, electronic records, and lifecycle data within a single validated system. The platform provides chain-of-custody visibility, audit-ready documentation, and operational oversight from discovery through commercialization.

With more than 100 years of combined industry experience, our leadership team supports biopharma, life sciences, and healthcare organizations consolidate and right-size storage using a proven framework that rationalizes legacy materials across the lifecycle – reducing compliance risk and eliminating the hidden costs of fragmented storage. 

Visit us on online to learn more about how to gain complete visibility, total control, and proven compliance with GXP-Storage.

# GXP-Storage Ltd

GXP-Storage Ltd is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. GXP-Storage® is an integrated regulated research and manufacturing material lifecycle management leader. They transform fragmented storage into strategic lifecycle regulated material management, with a capacity for millions of cubic feet. They have partnerships with 1,000+ organizations and offer expertise and leadership in various areas. GXP-Storage Ltd employs 4 people (-33.3% YoY, -2 people), founded in 1995. Headquartered in Kettering, Northamptonshire, United Kingdom, with an office in Glasgow.

## About

Qualogy’s Regulatory Archive Service is a fast growing, professional archive, providing high quality archive services in compliance with the Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations. Dedicated solely to the archiving of GxP regulated material we offer a personal service for each client based upon knowledge of the requirements, which are then geared to the needs of individual clients. 
Archive security and preventative measures are key to running a exceptional regulatory archive business.
Fire monitoring and security alarms, fire suppression system, laser beam smoke detection, CCTV, temperature and humidity control and continuous monitoring are all in place within the archive facilities.
With separate buildings on one site we are able to archive Investigator Site Files (ISF’s) and Trial Master Files (TMF’s) or back up material in separate buildings. Qualogy runs GCP and GLP archive training course twice throughout the year.

Through Qualogy’s long experience working with clients from around the world Qualogy has an unsurpassed expertise in assisting organisations improve the quality systems implemented for compliance with the global GxP regulations. 
Providing through its consultancy service guidance and expertise in the implementation and operation with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP). 

Qualogy designed an accreditation scheme to access a laboratories compliance with the standards of GCLP.
The Qualogy GCLP accreditation scheme involves the assessment of a clinical laboratory against the Good Clinical Laboratory (GCLP) standard as published by RQA, formerly the British Association of Research Quality Assurance (BARQA).

The Good Clinical Laboratory Practice guideline ISBN 978-1-904610-00-7, which has been adopted by the World Health Organisation (WHO), can be freely obtained from the RQA web site at www.therqa.com

The Qualogy GCLP accreditation scheme involves the assessment of a clinical laboratory against the Good Clinical Laboratory (GCLP) standard as published by RQA, formerly the British Association of Research Quality Assurance (BARQA).

The Good Clinical Laboratory Practice guideline ISBN 978-1-904610-00-7, which has been adopted by the World Health Organisation (WHO), can be freely obtained from the RQA web site at www.therqa.com
